A SYN Flood attack exploits which stage of the TCP connection lifecycle?

SYN flood sends a barrage of TCP SYN packets with spoofed source IPs without completing the 3rd ACK, exhausting the server's embryonic connection backlog queue (SYN queue).

⚡ GO Classes CS 2027 Style | Flow Control

In a Stop-and-Wait protocol, frame transmission time is 1 ms and round-trip propagation time is 9 ms. Processing and ACK times are negligible. What is the link utilization efficiency (in %)?

💡 Official Solution & Step-by-Step Derivation:
Efficiency $\eta = \frac{T_t}{T_t + RTT} = \frac{1}{1 + 9} = \frac{1}{10} = 10\%$.
